title: Versioned replay foundation
objective: Make replay dispatch explicit and fail-closed for immutable remediation evidence before introducing a compact record representation.

phases.title: Versioned replay contract
phases.objective: Define the typed version-dispatch boundary from evidence parsing through replay validation.

tasks.title: Model versioned replay witnesses
tasks.description: Introduce closed, strongly typed protocol/version discriminants for remediation results and replay witnesses; document the compatibility policy for v1 records and unknown future versions.
tasks.context: Debt-4 requires version-aware validation without coercing immutable evidence. This task establishes the contract and explicit unsupported path only.
acceptance_criteria: Known v1 evidence routes through an explicit v1 validator rather than the ambient current SprintFile parser.
Unknown record or witness versions produce an actionable fail-closed diagnostic.
The version model contains no arbitrary JSON or generic patch escape hatch.

evidence.summary: Added explicit version-dispatched replay witness parsing with typed v1 output and fail-closed unsupported handling.
evidence.notes: ADR-0001 records the v1 compatibility and future-version fail-closed policy.

checked_criteria: Known v1 evidence routes through an explicit v1 validator rather than the ambient current SprintFile parser.
Unknown record or witness versions produce an actionable fail-closed diagnostic.
The version model contains no arbitrary JSON or generic patch escape hatch.

phases.title: Historical compatibility vectors
phases.objective: Prove that the new dispatch preserves historical integrity and rejects unsupported evidence.

tasks.title: Certify version-aware replay vectors
tasks.description: Extend the real remediation and verification harnesses with v1 compatibility, unsupported-version, and multi-record chain cases.
tasks.context: Validation must cover real close/remediate flows and ensure historic checkpoints remain byte-identical.
acceptance_criteria: Existing v1 remediation chains remain verified without rewriting their records.
Unsupported version vectors fail closed in both doctor and status.
The regression harness proves checkpoint, snapshot, narrative, and ledger bytes remain unchanged.

evidence.summary: Certified explicit replay-witness dispatch with real v1 multi-record replay and unknown-version fail-closed vectors.
evidence.validation: OPENSSL_CONF=/private/tmp/kyro-empty-openssl.cnf npm run build; npm run check:replay-witness (5 assertions); npm run check:scope-remediation (295 assertions); npm run check:verification-states (152 assertions)

checked_criteria: Existing v1 remediation chains remain verified without rewriting their records.
Unsupported version vectors fail closed in both doctor and status.
The regression harness proves checkpoint, snapshot, narrative, and ledger bytes remain unchanged.

definitionOfDone: Version-aware replay dispatch is typed, fail-closed, and covered by real artifact vectors.
Historical v1 remediation chains remain valid without mutation.
npm run build, npm run check:scope-remediation, npm run check:verification-states, and npm run check pass.
